checks.status: passed after API revision 7: all Markdown fences balanced and stale-term search empty; this is a text audit, not a code gate

findings: The real specmark dependency is the materialized rust-ai-native-lang package path; no host source checkout is a valid seam.
redb 4.2.0 is MSRV-compatible but behavior and performance remain R04/R17 evidence, not an accepted claim.
A standalone Rust process cannot invoke harness-only native tools; the committed intent and harness receipt bridge is mandatory.
Legacy zap/1 digest domains and IDs remain separate from zap/2 identity and corrected reducer behavior.
Owner control is a distinct credentialed route; activation does not require an already active charter and coordinator action grants cannot yield OwnerControl.
Completion blockers are supplied by a fixed required provider composition, so absent economics/runtime providers cannot look like an empty blocker set.
Producer and acceptor identities come from service-created admission context and durable producer records, never caller payload authority.
deferred_evidence: R03/R05/R11 compilation and scoped tests prove the documented signatures and semantics.
R04 proves redb commit/reopen/quick-repair behavior; R17 measures its costs.
R11 captures actual native harness capabilities and reports unsupported operations honestly.
next_exact_action: No further R01 work. Root continues R03, R05 and R11; any later concrete contract defect is a bounded follow-up with an incremented API revision.
